question: What alternative terminal limits are permitted for the same architectural element?
premises: The element may end at the limit of the base.
The element may end at the jagatī moulding.
These options are presented as alternatives.
inference: The prescribed extent may terminate at either the base limit or the jagatī.
uncertainties: The subject carried over from the previous verse is implicit.
plain_english: It may extend up to the limit of the base, or likewise up to the jagatī.
